title: StringSchema
description: A JSON Schema subschema whose type is 'string' and which constrains string instances through at least one string-specific keyword: minLength, maxLength, pattern or format. A bare type: 'string' with no such keyword is not enough. Use SchemaProperty instead when the element is the named member of an object (its name, documentation, default, readOnly/writeOnly), rather than the string constraint set that the property references or embeds. Use SchemaDefinition instead when the string type is declared as a named, reusable entry under 'definitions' and referenced via $ref, especially an enumerated string type defined mainly by its enum values. Use Reference instead when the code only points to another schema via $ref and declares no length, pattern or format constraints of its own. Use SchemaComposition instead when string constraints are combined with other subschemas through allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, and the combination itself is the element being modelled.

type.description: The JSON Schema type keyword. Always set it to the literal 'string', the value that identifies this element as a string schema.

minLength.description: The minimum permitted number of characters (Unicode code points) in the string, as a non-negative integer; set it when empty or too-short values must be rejected.

maxLength.description: The maximum permitted number of characters (Unicode code points) in the string, as a non-negative integer no smaller than minLength; set it when the domain or a downstream field imposes a length limit.

pattern.description: An ECMA-262 regular expression that the string must match, unanchored unless ^ and $ are used; set it when values follow a fixed syntax such as codes or identifiers.

format.description: Semantic format hint for string values (JSON Schema Draft 7 format keyword)

x-dr-standard: JSON Schema Validation Draft 7 §6.3 Validation Keywords for Strings (maxLength, minLength, pattern) and §7 Semantic Validation with 'format'
x-dr-evidence: A JSON/YAML schema fragment of the form {"type": "string", "maxLength": 255, "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$"} or one carrying a "format" keyword, embedded in a schema file or OpenAPI components
A string field declared with validation constraints, such as Pydantic constr(min_length=…, regex=…) or Field(max_length=…), Zod z.string().min().max().email(), or Joi.string().pattern()
A Java/Kotlin String field annotated with Bean Validation constraints such as @Size(min=…, max=…), @Pattern(regexp=…), or @Email in an entity or DTO class
